slope.about: How steep the ground is, in degrees, between points ~1.9 km apart (MOLA).

elevation.about: Height above the average surface level (MOLA, MGS).

surface.about: Thermal inertia: low = fine dust, high = rocks and bedrock (TES, MGS). 70°S–70°N; nearer the poles seasonal frost spoils the readings.

iron.about: Iron in the top few tens of cm, as FeO weight % (gamma-ray spectrometer, Mars Odyssey). ~300 km pixels; none beyond ~60° latitude.

ice.about: Hydrogen in the top ~1 m, mostly water ice near the poles: how many fewer neutrons escape than over the driest ground (Mars Odyssey, ~12 Mars years; polar regions from their frost-free summers only). ~300 km pixels.

temperature.about: Average surface temperature over a Mars year. Calculated with a thermal model from TES albedo and thermal inertia and MOLA elevation; matches lander measurements within ~10 °C.

temp_range.about: Typical day-night swing (daily max - min, averaged over the year). Calculated with a thermal model from TES and MOLA data.

temp_yearly.about: Hottest minus coldest moment of the whole Mars year: daily swing plus seasons. Calculated with a thermal model from TES and MOLA data.

slope.about: How steep the ground is, in degrees, between points ~1.9 km apart (LOLA).

elevation.about: Height above the average surface level (LOLA, LRO).

surface.about: Share of the ground covered by rocks bigger than ~1 m (Diviner, LRO). 60°S–60°N.

iron.about: Iron in the soil, as FeO weight % (gamma-ray spectrometer, Lunar Prospector). ~60 km pixels. Dark volcanic plains are iron-rich, bright highlands iron-poor.

temperature.about: Average surface temperature over a whole lunar day and night (Diviner, LRO).

temp_range.about: Difference between the hottest and coldest time of a lunar day (Diviner, LRO).

elevation.about: Height above sea level (NOAA ETOPO 2022, from NASA SRTM and other data).

slope.about: How steep the ground is, in degrees, between points ~1.9 km apart - the same scale as the Moon and Mars slope maps (ETOPO 2022).

temp_max.about: Ground-surface temperature of the hottest month: its average daily maximum (NASA POWER, long-term average).

temp_min.about: Ground-surface temperature of the coldest month: its average daily minimum (NASA POWER, long-term average).

temp_range.about: Typical day-night swing of the ground-surface temperature, averaged over the year (NASA POWER).

dryness.about: Yearly rainfall: red = driest (least rain), blue = wettest (NASA POWER, from MERRA-2 and GPM).

uv.about: Ultraviolet at the ground: UV index averaged over day and night, including clouds (NASA POWER, from CERES). Midday peaks are several times higher.
